'''Pau Klaus Babot Müller''' (born 20 August 2003) is a [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[FC Bayern Alzenau]] in Germany's [[Regionalliga]]. Born in Germany, he is an Andorra international.

==Early life==
Babot was born on 1 August 2003 in [[Germany]] to an Andorran mother and a German father. Growing up, he attended the Schule am Ried in Germany.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wetterauer-zeitung.de/sport/lokalsport/babot-traeumt-eintracht-11990393.html|title=Pau Babot träumt von der Eintracht|trans-title=Pau Babot dreams of Eintracht|language=de|publisher={{ill|Wetterauer Zeitung|de}}|date=13 December 2017|access-date=28 November 2024}}</ref> He can speak [[Catalan language|Catalan]] and [[Spanish language|Spanish]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/sport/fussball/traum-von-laenderspielen-so-wird-man-nationalspieler-16489414.html|title=So wird man Nationalspieler|trans-title=How to become a national player|language=de|date=17 November 2019|access-date=28 November 2024}}</ref>

==Club career==
As a youth player, Babot joined the [[youth academy]] of FC Germania Enkheim. Three years later, he joined the youth academy of FSV 1910 Bergen, before joining the youth academy of [[KSV Klein-Karben]], where he captained the under-14 team. In 2022, he started his career with {{ill|SG Bornheim Grün-Weiss|de}}. Ahead of the second half of the [[2023–24 in German football|2023–24 season]], he signed for Hanauer SC 1960. 

==International career==
Babot played for the [[Andorra national under-17 football team]] for [[2020 UEFA European Under-17 Championship qualification]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://inside.fifa.com/news/andorra-babot-emails-his-way-into-international-football|title=Babot emails his way into international football|trans-title=|language=en|publisher=[[FIFA]]|date=21 October 2019|access-date=28 November 2024}}</ref> The same year, he played for the [[Andorra national under-19 football team]]. On 19 October 2024, he debuted for the [[Andorra national football team]] during a 0–0 away draw with the [[Malta national football team]] in the [[UEFA Nations League]].
